title: HybridMatchFinderContract
description: JSON Schema defining input, execution constraints, and output for hybrid SWAR/NEON longest-match comparison kernel

src0_offset.description: Offset in bytes from base pointer for search target

src1_offset.description: Offset in bytes from base pointer for match candidate

max_len.description: Upper bound for match length comparison

match_length.description: Contiguous identical byte count found between src0 and src1

dispatch_path.description: Exact internal execution path that resolved the comparison
